defect: NO VALID ANCHOR/SHIP PAIR -- both slots hold the SAME coverage-instrumented build
defect_detail: php_anchor and php_ship were meant to be reconfigured without --coverage (anchor: CFLAGS=-O0 -g -fwrapv; ship: default optimized). Every reconfigure attempt failed with 'configure: error: Package requirements (libxml-2.0 >= 2.7.6) were not met: Package libxml-2.0 not found' (pkg-config has no libxml-2.0.pc in this container). apt-get update returned exit=100 (network blocked for the apt mirror from inside the agent lane), so libxml2-dev could not be installed either. Because ./configure exited nonzero, make reused the STALE config.status/Makefile left over from the original --coverage build of /persist/php, so 'make' still succeeded (exit 0) but relinked the SAME coverage-instrumented object files into both the anchor and ship binary paths. Confirmed by evidence, not assumed: nm shows __gcov0.* / __gcov_.* symbols in BOTH binaries (13352 each); the objdump bytes for add_function are byte-identical between the two (diff empty); only the embedded build timestamp string differs (md5sums differ for that reason alone).
what_this_means: The instruction counts below are REAL disassembly of REAL PHP 7.4.33 code, but they are ONE build (coverage-instrumented, -O0 baseline per CPython's own note that OPT is placed before user CFLAGS so a trailing -O0 -g --coverage combination took effect), not an anchor-vs-ship PAIR. No ship/anchor delta claim can be made for php. This is recorded as a diagnosed dead end within this session's budget, not silently patched over.
